subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic-native compaction be exposed as model/run params, as part of the existing compaction provider seam, or as a narrower Anthropic provider-owned setting?
rationale: The missing work crosses public config, provider request payloads, streaming/session-state semantics, and a broader open Anthropic context-management request, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape alone.

options.title: Provider-owned opt-in parameters
options.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in model/run parameters and docs while keeping local/pluggable compaction behavior unchanged by default.

options.title: Compaction provider integration
options.body: Route Anthropic native compaction through the existing compaction provider selection model, which keeps one compaction surface but may stretch the provider registry beyond summarization backends.

options.title: Fold into broader context-management design
options.body: Keep this issue open as the focused compaction tracker but wait for #54041 to settle headers, memory/context editing, and security boundaries together.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned opt-in parameters
recommendation.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in model/run parameters and docs while keeping local/pluggable compaction behavior unchanged by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest adjacent history tying server-side compaction precedent, Anthropic provider review context, and prior discussion on this issue.
